title: Little Boy with Toy Wheelbarrow in Yard, c. 1940 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming full-length portrait of a toddler standing in a gravel yard holding a miniature toy wheelbarrow. The boy is bundled in a knit skullcap, dark buttoned cardigan sweater, long trousers, and sturdy shoes, gazing intently toward the photographer. Behind him sits a sunlit white picket fence, leafy trees, and a classic American clapboard house with gridded multi-pane windows. Black paper mounting residue on the corners of the back indicates the photograph was preserved in a traditional vintage scrapbook album, embodying the quiet, idyllic nature of mid-century suburban childhood.
